paras: Proudly presenting you Leyo Motorsport Cold Air Intake for the facelifted Audi 8V RS3 with the all new 400HP aluminum block. This intake builds on the airbox design of our pre-facelift RS3 intake while integrating factory dampening design on the intake pipe. The intake pipe with the wide 100mm filter flange tapering to 76mm creating a velocity stack design efficiently feeds cold air into the turbo.

Specially designed air box prevents heat soak, effectively extracting colder induction air. For those that wants the open airbox design, Leyo RS3 intake airbox can be both enclosed or open. No fabrication required for installation, bolts straight onto factory mounting points.
hl: Double cone intake for maximum induction.
